procedure: Resample question identities within each original fold. Carry one multiplicity weight per identity into every fold-specific training fit and held-out evaluation. All copies of a question remain in its original fold. Refit base rate, isotonic and logistic in every replicate. No test item appears in its calibration training folds.
scope: Accounts for empirical sampling and calibrator refitting, conditional on frozen fold allocation, retained outputs and serving configurations. Does not model source-cluster dependence or new model generation. No multiplicity adjustment.
